Public/media responses are no-store. Unknown request body/query fields are rejected; responses allow additive fields.

X-Device-ID.name: X-Device-ID
X-Device-ID.description: Required exactly once, including anonymous/media requests. No blank/control/comma-joined values. Probe and CORS preflight are exempt.

X-Device-OS.name: X-Device-OS
X-Device-OS.description: Required exactly once, including anonymous/media requests. No blank/control/comma-joined values. Probe and CORS preflight are exempt.

X-Device-Version.name: X-Device-Version
X-Device-Version.description: Required exactly once, including anonymous/media requests. No blank/control/comma-joined values. Probe and CORS preflight are exempt.

X-App-Version.name: X-App-Version
X-App-Version.description: Required exactly once, including anonymous/media requests. No blank/control/comma-joined values. Probe and CORS preflight are exempt. Strict SemVer with optional build metadata.

X-App-Language.name: X-App-Language
X-App-Language.description: Required exactly once, including anonymous/media requests. No blank/control/comma-joined values. Probe and CORS preflight are exempt. One well-formed BCP 47 language tag, including valid unsupported languages.

ExpectedVersion.name: X-Expected-Version
ExpectedVersion.description: Committed resource version. Missing 428; malformed 400; stale 412. Replay follows current authorization and precedes current-version checks.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID v4. Scope: identity UID + method + path + key. Semantic input includes expected version, excludes credentials/device/trace. Successful results replay for 24 hours.

Traceparent.name: traceparent
Traceparent.description: W3C trace context. Invalid/all-zero context is replaced, never used for authorization.

IdentityPlatformToken.description: Verified Google provider, email, signature, issuer/audience, expiry/revocation. Raw Google OAuth ID tokens are invalid. Current SQL membership/visibility is checked on protected operations.

WebSession.name: X-Blogpost-Web-Session
WebSession.description: Verified five-day Identity Platform session cookie forwarded by the server proxy only. Never combine with Authorization. Current SQL membership is authoritative.
